svg.text: Africa extension: NMF topic map from the ten source word clouds
TF-IDF + NMF, 10 factors. Coursework-reported coherence c_v = 0.5464.

g.text: Topic 0 · Apartheid / Southern Africa
south · namibia · apartheid · regime · resolution
Southern African liberation and apartheid-era diplomacy.
Topic 1 · Sustainable development
global · sustainable · 2015 · goal · millennium · poverty
Global goals, poverty and the MDG/2015 development agenda.
Topic 2 · Guinea / rights / governance
guinea · equatorial · bissau · republic · human · right
Country-focused governance and human-rights vocabulary.
Topic 3 · North Africa / Maghreb
morocco · tunisia · arab · egypt · palestinian · maghreb
North African, Arab and Mediterranean geopolitics.
Topic 4 · Swaziland / monarchy / diplomacy
swaziland · kingdom · majesty · swazi · taiwan · china
Monarchy, national identity and external diplomatic relations.
Topic 5 · Horn of Africa
ethiopia · somalia · eritrea · sudan · IGAD · kenya
Conflict and regional cooperation in the Horn.
Topic 6 · Independence / struggle
power · independence · struggle · right · regime · territory
Self-determination, political struggle and territorial questions.
Topic 7 · Malawi / health / food
malawi · HIV · food · AIDS · mozambique · government
Health, food security and country-specific development.
Topic 8 · Chad / Libya / Darfur
chad · libya · sudan · government · darfur
Cross-border insecurity and conflict in North/Central Africa.
Topic 9 · Great Lakes conflict
burundi · rwanda · congo · conflict · democratic · political
Conflict, governance and political transition in the Great Lakes.

svg.text: Interpretation: NMF produces relatively legible factors, but several are strongly anchored by country names—an important feature of the unsupervised solution.
